finding: concept-history-check paired the double quotation marks of a record's whole Evidence section in order. A source with quotation marks of its own, such as the RFC grammar in A3-SR-01 and A3-SR-05 or the inner marks in A4-SR-09, shifted every later pair. Real quotes then failed to anchor, so RFC 733, the RFC 5322 phrase rule, and one framing criticism dropped out of the knowledge-across-sources histories. The shift could also pair a note between two passages as a quote. Fix: pair marks inside one bullet or paragraph, and anchor a quote that holds marks of its own when it is a whole quoted passage.
why_this_severity: The report writer noticed the dropped quotes and stated the gap in the report, so no wrong history shipped (no to harms_downstream), and the survey still answered its brief (no to fails_purpose). The histories need a second writer pass.
